reason: Deployment evidence now supersedes the initial pledge list. Mexico has sent 250 rescuers, the Dominican Republic was the first foreign contingent to reach La Guaira, Spain has sent nearly 100, and the United States is deploying two specialist urban-search teams. China now says it will send a rescue team, making a China-Venezuela joint extraction newly plausible; host-plus-foreign cooperation remains the dominant structural path.

Antonelli led Russell by 0.040 seconds in an Austrian FP1 Mercedes one-two and has won five of seven races. Piastri was third, while Hamilton was 0.665 seconds back and both Red Bull and McLaren lost practice time to reliability problems. This strengthens Antonelli materially and makes Russell the clearest alternative.
